candidates.name: Khaki Short-Sleeve Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only cutout supplies no worn fit or Premium fiber proof, while the washed khaki tone lacks the desired Summer energy.

candidates.name: Green Short-Sleeve Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The saturated green is useful, but the isolated basic tee form proves neither Premium yarn nor refined on-body proportion.

candidates.name: White Short-Sleeve Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The crumpled hanger overshirt, tee dependency, rolled sleeves and long rounded hem show Casual construction rather than Premium evening shirting.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Ribbed Short-Sleeve Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The cropped narrow form, bunching, hem badge and absence of full worn proof prevent a Premium fit or yarn approval.

candidates.name: Lake-Blue Long-Sleeve Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Hanger-only tee layering, rolled cuffs, novelty embroidery and a long overshirt body lack Premium Formal precision.

candidates.name: Pale-Brown Relaxed Summer Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The open-over-tee presentation, dropped shoulders, long body and backpack styling are Casual overshirt signals, not Premium Formal.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: Elastic drawstring waist, patch pockets, crumpled cloth, rolled hems and barefoot beach styling are lounge construction.

candidates.name: Flax-Coffee Lightweight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The gathered waist, black athletic drawcord and puddled sneaker hem fail Premium tailoring and exact-drape requirements.

candidates.name: Light-Tan Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: An exposed rope drawstring, broad lounge leg and pooling hem cannot be promoted to Premium Formal because the color is pale.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The product crop hides rise, seat, full drape and break; technical knee seams and smooth cloth do not establish Premium tailoring.

candidates.name: Gray Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: Gathered elastic, rope drawcord, D-ring and soft synthetic construction are lounge details incompatible with Premium Formal.

candidates.name: White Lightweight Button-Up Blazer
candidates.decisionReason: Washed translucent cloth, bunched sleeves, T-shirt styling and generic patch pockets fail Premium blazer construction and finish.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Lightweight Shacket
candidates.decisionReason: The sky blue is attractive, but the rumpled rolled-cuff open shacket and jeans styling remain Resort-level rather than Premium Formal tailoring.
